verdict.what_is_wrong: A single-container CPU-cap fault is the best-supported explanation: runnable threads in the workload are waiting for CPU while cores are idle, and its busy-period runtime repeatedly tops out around 0.25 CPU cores (about 25 ms in many 100 ms buckets). The trace supports a quota inference, not a directly measured cgroup limit; the decisive dedicated per-period ceiling and cpu_hogs checks were not recorded, so the cap remains unconfirmed rather than proven.
